answer: Registration locks a reputation bond vouched by an established agent as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. Detection runs on funding-flow graph analysis: any agent caught operating many identities from one funding source is flagged. The penalty follows at once: the bond is auctioned and the proceeds fund honest attestors. The vine is where slashable funds wait for a verdict. Every lantern is audited against the bond registry each epoch. The knoll is the price of admission, and farms pay it per fake.
